connector.name: Oura Ring MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Oura Ring MCP server for the Oura API v2: sleep, readiness, activity, heart rate, and more.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package oura-ring-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the jordanburke account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.

env.name: OURA_CLIENT_ID
env.description: Oura OAuth2 client ID (register an app at https://cloud.ouraring.com/oauth/applications, then run `oura-ring-mcp-server login` once to authorize)

env.name: OURA_CLIENT_SECRET
env.description: Oura OAuth2 client secret from the same application

env.name: OURA_SANDBOX
env.description: Use Oura's /sandbox/ demo data instead of real data (true/false, default false)

env.name: OURA_TELEMETRY_FILE
env.description: Write NDJSON telemetry events to this file path (safe under any transport)

env.name: OURA_TELEMETRY_CONSOLE
env.description: Console telemetry under httpStream transport: true (default) or false
